On balance these offsetting signals net to approximately zero, pointing to a hold at the December meeting.

The pre-read shows unemployment (4.2) sitting exactly at the natural rate (u_star 4.2) with a gap of 0.0, a low Sahm reading (0.033), and subdued claims, none of which demand a move. Weighing the sub-breakeven payrolls against the otherwise balanced readings yields a net tilt of -1 bp.
